gate.title: Install French ECU
gate.intro: French ECU works as an app: install it on your phone, tablet or computer to access the tools.
gate.native_hint: Installation takes a few seconds. Then open French ECU from its icon.
gate.ios_s1: Tap the Share button (the square with an up arrow), at the bottom of Safari or at the top on iPad.
gate.ios_s2: Scroll down and choose “Add to Home Screen”.
gate.ios_s3: Tap “Add”, then open French ECU from its icon.
gate.android_s1: Open the browser menu (⋮ at the top right).
gate.android_s2: Choose “Install app” or “Add to Home screen”.
gate.android_s3: Open French ECU from its icon.
gate.desktop_s1: Click the install icon in the address bar, or open the browser menu (⋮ or …).
gate.desktop_s3: The app opens in its own window.
gate.mac_s1: In Safari, open the File menu.
gate.mac_s3: Open French ECU from the Dock.
gate.inapp_title: Open this link in your browser
gate.inapp_text: The app can't be installed from an in-app browser (Facebook, Instagram, Messenger…). Copy the link and open it in Chrome or Safari.
gate.unsupported: This browser can't install apps. Open this link with Google Chrome or Microsoft Edge (or Safari on Mac).
gate.installed: Installation complete! Open French ECU from the icon on your home screen.
gate.already: Already installed? Open it from the French ECU icon.
